description: Frozen S2.5 core requests for complete membership lists and first-K containing layers in manifest order. Each wording binds only the selected multiplex, scope, gene, and explicit bound. Diagnostics preserve invalid or missing request values without treating them as measured graph absence. Four variants per kind and split are frozen as data, independent of graph outcomes and generation budgets. No language model runs at build time; human wording review remains available.
